summary: Beyond Air, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting stockholder approval of a reverse stock split at a special meeting held June 18, 2026. The board was authorized to effect a split between 1-for-2 and 1-for-20 and immediately approved a 1-for-20 ratio. The split is intended to raise the per-share bid price above $1.00 to regain compliance with Nasdaq listing standards. No other matters were voted upon. This is a routine capital structure adjustment, not a special situation.
